intro_npc.name: Old Mechanic
lines: Hey, kid. You're new here, aren't you?
The wasteland is unforgiving. You'll need more than just that pistol.
I've got an old tank in the back. She's seen better days, but she'll run.
If you can scrape together some parts, I'll help you fix her up.
Oh, and watch out for the Sand Worm. There's a bounty on it.
Head north to the ruins if you're feeling brave. Good hunting.

shop_npc.name: Shopkeeper
lines: Welcome to my shop. Everything's salvaged, everything's for sale.
Buy something, or get out. I don't do window shopping.

bounty_board.name: Bounty Board
lines: Sand Worm - 1000G - Last seen in the northern desert
Iron Titan - 5000G - Roams the eastern ruins

tank_get.name: Old Mechanic
lines: There she is. A bit rusty, but the engine still turns over.
I've installed a basic chassis and engine. The rest is up to you.
Talk to me at the garage anytime to swap parts.
Remember: heavier chassis means more defense but fewer slots.
Now get out there and earn some gold!
